name: Workspace State Authoritative Return Hotfix
title: Cloudflare Asset Size Guard Hotfix
summary: Prevent Cloudflare deployments from uploading unsupported oversized source assets.
changes: Added a root .assetsignore for non-web source media, archives and the Worker entrypoint.
Added a Cloudflare 25 MiB asset preflight checker for release validation.
Preserved web-ready image formats and the existing public website runtime.
manual_review: Verify return position in the deployed browser environment using both in-page back links and the browser back button.
